title: review-strategy.json of a batch
description: How the batch of a run is reviewed (<run>/review-strategy.json, application/review_plan.py decide): the mode, the groups of pieces read together and the effort of the reviewer. Chosen once before the first piece; the same plan is state.review_strategy, and a resume that finds the file but not the state takes the file.

mode.description: each (every piece on its own), groups, single (the batch at once) or none.

groups.description: Groups of piece references, in order; numbered from 1 by settle --group.

source.description: Who chose it: rules, option (review.strategy) or model (the strategist).

effort.description: Planned effort of the group reviewer.
